headline: Twelve people who started exactly where you are.
intro_text: Nine of our twelve coaches came up through our own beginner classes. They remember being the nervous one at the back, which is most of the qualification.

lead_coach.image_alt: Andy Pearson, head coach, in the training hall.
lead_coach.name: Andy Pearson
lead_coach.quote: “The job isn't to make you brave. It's to break the thing you're scared of into six pieces small enough that you're not.”
